rationale: The original short thesis relied on downward continuation below the 5-minute 9-EMA, which is now failing as price trades at $43.30 above the $43.29 5-minute 9-EMA. After making a session low at $43.12 (0.36% MFE) without reaching the $43.00 target, BP has printed three consecutive green 1-minute candles on steadily increasing volume (4,431 to 6,227 shares), reclaimed the $43.27 entry price, and erased the unrealized gain. Exiting now limits the loss to roughly -$5 rather than waiting to hit the $43.40 invalidation as short-term momentum reverses upward.
